SELECT C.COMPANION_NO, C.TITLE, C.CONTENT, C.IMAGE_URL, C.TRAVEL_DATE, C.MAX_MEMBERS, C.TAGS, C.STATUS, C.MEMBER_NO, C.CONTENT_IMAGES, C.LATITUDE, C.LONGITUDE, C.PLACE_NAME, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(C.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS AUTHOR_PROFILE, M.AGE_RANGE AS AUTHOR_AGE_RANGE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_JOIN J WHERE J.COMPANION_NO = C.COMPANION_NO AND J.STATUS IN ('W', 'A') ) AS CURRENT_MEMBERS FROM COMPANION_BOARD C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE C.COMPANION_NO = #{companionNo} AND C.STATUS != 'N'

SELECT J.JOIN_NO, J.COMPANION_NO, J.MEMBER_NO, J.STATUS, TO_CHAR(J.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS MEMBER_PROFILE FROM COMPANION_JOIN J JOIN MEMBER M ON J.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE J.COMPANION_NO = #{companionNo} AND J.STATUS != 'C' ORDER BY J.CREATED_AT ASC
